# One-way ANOVA power calculation
# Given: 3 groups, total N = 75, eta-squared = 0.08, alpha = 0.05

# Input parameters
k <- 3                    # number of groups
N <- 75                   # total sample size
n_per_group <- N / k      # n per group (balanced design)
eta_sq <- 0.08            # population effect size (eta-squared)
alpha <- 0.05             # significance level

# Degrees of freedom
df1 <- k - 1              # numerator df (between-groups)
df2 <- N - k              # denominator df (within-groups/error)

# Convert eta-squared to noncentrality parameter (lambda)
# Relationship: eta_sq = SS_between / SS_total = (lambda * MS_between) / (SS_total)
# For noncentral F: lambda = f^2 * df2 where f^2 = eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)
f_sq <- eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)
lambda <- f_sq * df2

# Calculate critical F-value at alpha level
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1, df2)

# Calculate power using noncentral F distribution
# Power = P(F > F_crit | H1 is true) = P(noncentral F > F_crit)
power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df1, df2, ncp = lambda)

# Display results
cat("One-Way ANOVA Power Calculation\n")
cat("================================\n")
cat(sprintf("Number of groups (k):         %d\n", k))
cat(sprintf("Total sample size (N):        %d\n", N))
cat(sprintf("Sample size per group (n):    %d\n", n_per_group))
cat(sprintf("Population eta-squared:       %.4f\n", eta_sq))
cat(sprintf("Significance level (alpha):   %.4f\n", alpha))
cat(sprintf("\nDegrees of freedom:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Numerator (df1 = k-1):      %d\n", df1))
cat(sprintf("  Denominator (df2 = N-k):    %d\n", df2))
cat(sprintf("\nEffect size conversion:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  f-squared (eta_sq/(1-eta_sq)): %.6f\n", f_sq))
cat(sprintf("  Noncentrality parameter:    %.6f\n", lambda))
cat(sprintf("  Critical F-value (F_crit):  %.6f\n", F_crit))
cat(sprintf("\nPower (omnibus F-test):       %.6f\n", power))

# Return structured result
results <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(results)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# One-way ANOVA power calculation
# Given: 3 groups, total N = 75, eta-squared = 0.08, alpha = 0.05

# Input parameters
k <- 3                    # number of groups
N <- 75                   # total sample size
n_per_group <- N / k      # n per group (balanced design)
eta_sq <- 0.08            # population effect size (eta-squared)
alpha <- 0.05             # significance level

# Degrees of freedom
df1 <- k - 1              # numerator df (between-groups)
df2 <- N - k              # denominator df (within-groups/error)

# Convert eta-squared to noncentrality parameter (lambda)
# Relationship: eta_sq = SS_between / SS_total = (lambda * MS_between) / (SS_total)
# For noncentral F: lambda = f^2 * df2 where f^2 = eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)
f_sq <- eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)
lambda <- f_sq * df2

# Calculate critical F-value at alpha level
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1, df2)

# Calculate power using noncentral F distribution
# Power = P(F > F_crit | H1 is true) = P(noncentral F > F_crit)
power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df1, df2, ncp = lambda)

# Display results
cat("One-Way ANOVA Power Calculation\n")
cat("================================\n")
cat(sprintf("Number of groups (k):         %d\n", k))
cat(sprintf("Total sample size (N):        %d\n", N))
cat(sprintf("Sample size per group (n):    %d\n", n_per_group))
cat(sprintf("Population eta-squared:       %.4f\n", eta_sq))
cat(sprintf("Significance level (alpha):   %.4f\n", alpha))
cat(sprintf("\nDegrees of freedom:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Numerator (df1 = k-1):      %d\n", df1))
cat(sprintf("  Denominator (df2 = N-k):    %d\n", df2))
cat(sprintf("\nEffect size conversion:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  f-squared (eta_sq/(1-eta_sq)): %.6f\n", f_sq))
cat(sprintf("  Noncentrality parameter:    %.6f\n", lambda))
cat(sprintf("  Critical F-value (F_crit):  %.6f\n", F_crit))
cat(sprintf("\nPower (omnibus F-test):       %.6f\n", power))

# Return structured result
results <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(results)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Evidence e1; success=true

# One-way ANOVA power calculation
# Given: 3 groups, total N = 75, eta-squared = 0.08, alpha = 0.05

# Input parameters
k <- 3                    # number of groups
N <- 75                   # total sample size
n_per_group <- N / k      # n per group (balanced design)
eta_sq <- 0.08            # population effect size (eta-squared)
alpha <- 0.05             # significance level

# Degrees of freedom
df1 <- k - 1              # numerator df (between-groups)
df2 <- N - k              # denominator df (within-groups/error)

# Convert eta-squared to noncentrality parameter (lambda)
# Relationship: eta_sq = SS_between / SS_total = (lambda * MS_between) / (SS_total)
# For noncentral F: lambda = f^2 * df2 where f^2 = eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)
f_sq <- eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)
lambda <- f_sq * df2

# Calculate critical F-value at alpha level
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1, df2)

# Calculate power using noncentral F distribution
# Power = P(F > F_crit | H1 is true) = P(noncentral F > F_crit)
power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df1, df2, ncp = lambda)

# Display results
cat("One-Way ANOVA Power Calculation\n")
cat("================================\n")
cat(sprintf("Number of groups (k):         %d\n", k))
cat(sprintf("Total sample size (N):        %d\n", N))
cat(sprintf("Sample size per group (n):    %d\n", n_per_group))
cat(sprintf("Population eta-squared:       %.4f\n", eta_sq))
cat(sprintf("Significance level (alpha):   %.4f\n", alpha))
cat(sprintf("\nDegrees of freedom:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Numerator (df1 = k-1):      %d\n", df1))
cat(sprintf("  Denominator (df2 = N-k):    %d\n", df2))
cat(sprintf("\nEffect size conversion:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  f-squared (eta_sq/(1-eta_sq)): %.6f\n", f_sq))
cat(sprintf("  Noncentrality parameter:    %.6f\n", lambda))
cat(sprintf("  Critical F-value (F_crit):  %.6f\n", F_crit))
cat(sprintf("\nPower (omnibus F-test):       %.6f\n", power))

# Return structured result
results <- list(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(results)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Solving for f: f^2 = eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)
f_sq <- eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)
f <- sqrt(f_sq)

df_between <- k - 1
df_within <- N - k

# This is based on the definition of the noncentral F distribution

# Step 5: Power calculation
# Power = P(F_observed > F_critical | H1 is true)
# Under H1, F follows noncentral F(df_between, df_within, lambda)
power <- 1 - pf(F_critical, df_between, df_within, ncp = lambda)

cat("========================================\n\n")
